decisions.reason: As a recent extension of the firm’s established airport systems offer, launched in a growing industry by a hiring, R&D-active firm with some organisational slack, it is likely to be retained unless early results clearly disappoint, and the strong website positioning suggests satisfactory expectations.

This product also fits the firm’s integrated airport-operations strategy and a resource-rich innovative context makes continued support likely, though the weaker public signal versus Product A leaves somewhat more uncertainty about whether it is already meeting aspirations.
